resources.string: Shows your pause or time\'s-up screen when you open an app you chose.

STOIC uses this only to see which app is in front, so it can show the pause, daily-limit or focus screen for the apps you picked. It cannot read what is on your screen or what you type, and nothing leaves your phone.
You asked for a short pause before opening %1$s. Is this important right now?
You set a daily limit of %1$d minutes for %2$s, and you\'ve reached it. It starts fresh at midnight.
%1$s is paused until your session ends at %2$s. Pebble is growing.
Open anyway, available in a few seconds
You set this up in STOIC. You can change it there any time.
